text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur, the theoretical Umamusume. 
Though she finds conversing with Fine 
Motion bothersome, she seems quite 
interested in her data.

This one is clearly different from the 
other Umamusume— Air Shakur saw in her the 
potential to change his own destiny...

Air Shakur mutters words heavy with 
meaning. Keep your eyes on 'er, properly— 
Getter to run "all the way to the end" is 
your job—

Just what kind of view was she seeing...? 
The Trainer kept the question tucked away 
in their heart.
